gloss: core, crux, heart of a matter

definitions.gloss: core, crux, heart of a matter
definitions.explanation: The most important or central point of an issue, problem, or argument. Used when referring to the essential part that everything else revolves around.

examples.japanese: {問題|もんだい}の{核心|かくしん}に{触|ふ}れる。
examples.english: To touch on the crux of the problem.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{話|はなし}は{核心|かくしん}を{突|つ}いていた。
examples.english: His remarks hit the heart of the matter.

examples.japanese: {議論|ぎろん}が{長引|ながび}いているが、そろそろ{核心|かくしん}に{迫|せま}るべきだ。
examples.english: The discussion has been dragging on, but it's time we got to the heart of the matter.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {核心|かくしん}に{触|ふ}れる: to touch on the core issue
- {核心|かくしん}を{突|つ}く: to hit the nail on the head
- {核心|かくしん}に{迫|せま}る: to get to the heart of the matter
- {核心|かくしん}{部分|ぶぶん}: the core part

SIMILAR WORDS:
{核心|かくしん} focuses on the most critical point of an argument or issue. {要点|ようてん} (key point) is broader and more neutral, while {核心|かくしん} emphasizes the idea of penetrating to the essential center.
